description: apps.manifest.create returns the new app's `verification_token`, the legacy shared secret Slack sends with every Events API and interactivity request. Mark it sensitive like `client_secret` and `signing_secret` beside it. See https://docs.slack.dev/authentication/verifying-requests-from-slack#deprecation The response's `app_token` (an app-level token, sent for apps that use Socket Mode) is a credential too.
